items.title: Gucci maker Kering’s long-time focus on materials innovation pays off
items.summary: Kering, the $14.5 billion French luxury company behind Gucci, Saint Laurent and Bottega Veneta, has reduced its absolute greenhouse gas emissions by one-third since 2022.

items.title: Google’s $15bn India data centre project faces water and environmental challenges
items.summary: Google’s planned $15bn data centre hub in Andhra Pradesh, India, is facing growing opposition from environmental activists over water use and its proximity to wildlife habitat, even as construction at the site moves ahead.

items.title: All surface water in England polluted by chemicals
items.summary: All bodies of water across England contain pollutants and toxic chemicals, according to new government data that found that less than 15% of surface water has achieved ‘good’ status for ecology.

items.title: National Grid purchases 300 BNG units for Yorkshire green grid venture
items.summary: National Grid will purchase around 300 biodiversity units to deliver Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG) for its £400m green grid project in Yorkshire.

items.summary: 您使用的瀏覽器版本較舊，已不再受支援。建議您更新瀏覽器版本，以獲得最佳使用體驗。環境部長彭啓明今天(7日)表示，台灣最新國家自定貢獻(NDC 3.0)將2030年減碳目標由24%提高至28±2%，未來每年減碳幅度更提高至4%至5%，挑戰相當大，但環境部認為，2030年目標仍在既定渠道上，甚至有機會提前達標。

items.summary: 永續作為逐漸成為企業基本條件，在面對國際規範升級與市場對永續實績要求的新時代，更該思考如何提升成效，強化競爭及加速成長動能。
